name: namche-brand-studio
description: NAMCHE Brand Studio — metaball engine packages and the Brand Studio app

scripts.build: npm run build -w @namche/metaball && npm run build -w @namche/metaball-react && npm run build -w @namche/metaball-svg && npm run build -w @namche/brand-studio
scripts.build:renderer: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @namche/metaball-react
scripts.test: npm run test -w @namche/metaball && npm run test -w @namche/metaball-react && npm run test -w @namche/metaball-svg && npm run test -w @namche/brand-studio && npm run verify:skill-links
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @namche/metaball-react && npm run lint -w @namche/metaball-svg && npm run lint -w @namche/brand-studio
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:renderer && npm run typecheck -w @namche/brand-studio
scripts.release:dry-run: npm pack --dry-run -w @namche/metaball && npm pack --dry-run -w @namche/metaball-react && npm pack --dry-run -w @namche/metaball-svg
scripts.build:svg: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @namche/metaball-svg
